name: get_project
description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific project by its Project ID. Returns budget details, owner, status, and description.

projectId.description: The unique project identifier (e.g., PROJ-001, PROJ-010)

name: list_department_projects
description: Lists all projects assigned to a specific department. Returns the count and details of projects for that department.

department.description: The department name (e.g., Engineering, Marketing, DevOps, Sales, Finance)

name: filter_by_budget
description: Finds projects within a specified total budget range. Can specify a minimum budget, a maximum budget, or both to filter the project list.

min_budget.description: Minimum budget amount in USD (e.g., 10000). Optional.

max_budget.description: Maximum budget amount in USD (e.g., 50000). Optional.

name: list_by_status
description: Filters projects based on their current operational status (e.g., finding all projects that are 'At Risk' or 'Completed').

status.description: The status of the project (e.g., Active, In Progress, Completed, At Risk, Planning)

name: list_all_projects
description: Retrieves the complete list of all projects across the organization. Use this for general queries or overviews when no specific filter is requested.
